title: Finite quasi-coherent filtration of the reduction units kernel
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and $i:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ its reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. Let $K=\ker(i^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,X_{\mathrm{red}}})$ in abelian etale sheaves [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. There exist $n\geq0$ and sheaves $E_j$ on $(X_{\mathrm{red}})_{\mathrm{Et}}$ with $E_0\simeq K$, $E_n=0$, and, for each $0\leq j<n$, a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $F_j$ and a short exact sequence $0\to E_{j+1}\to E_j\to i^{-1}(F_j)_{\mathrm{Et}}\to0$ [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. The additive coefficients are lifted to the universe of $\mathbf G_m$.

proof.text: The nilradical N of the Noetherian scheme is coherent and nilpotent: choose a finite affine cover and the maximum of the affine nilpotence exponents. On etale affines, flat pullback preserves N and its powers, and the quotient by the pulled-back N is reduced, since it is etale over X_red. Thus the kernel of restriction of units is 1+N.

Choose m>=1 with N^m=0. Filter 1+N by 1+N^(j+1), for 0<=j<=m-1. Multiplication becomes addition modulo N^(j+2), since 2j+2>=j+2. The quotient is the associated additive sheaf of the quasi-coherent module N^(j+1)/N^(j+2), and local unit lifting gives the short exact sequences. Lift the coefficients sectionwise; this preserves exactness.

Reduction is a universal homeomorphism, so its inverse image is an exact equivalence. Pull back the filtration and its short exact sequences. The adjunction counit on G_m,X_red is invertible; applying inverse image to the original units comparison and then the counit gives upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf. Preservation of kernels identifies the first term with its kernel. The final term is zero. Reduced and empty schemes have the zero-length filtration.
